text: The clinic has a nice atmosphere.
Dr. Paisal is very skilled and has a gentle touch. Extracting and operating wisdom teeth was painless. I've been getting dental work done by him for almost 20 years.
I had a tooth extracted there, and the dentist and assistant were friendly. They were persuasive in making the extraction painless, and the price was reasonable.
author_name: เอเอแอล ธุรกิจ (AAL)

text: I went for treatment at Paisarn Clinic. The doctor I encountered didn't have a license and couldn't disclose their name to clients. When I asked again, they changed the doctor's name, and that doctor wasn't even on the dental registry. I don't know who they hired to treat me. They also rushed to give me a local anesthetic without my permission. Please be careful, and I urge clinics to verify the doctor's qualifications.
